content.user_title: Design a compliant B2B cold outreach sequence
content.value_statement: Cold outreach needs clear timing, safe stopping rules, and deliverability planning. This skill produces a sequence map, reply routing, warmup schedule, and compliance guardrails.
actual_capabilities: Maps multi-step B2B outreach with timing, goals, and exit rules.
Routes positive, objection, referral, not-now, and opt-out replies.
Creates an estimated mailbox warmup ramp and daily sending cap.
Lists CAN-SPAM elements and flags consent-first jurisdictions.
Reviews sender-integrity evidence without calculating a final quality score.
limitations: Does not send email or connect to an email platform automatically.
Does not create individual subject lines, bodies, or calls to action.
Does not verify legal compliance or replace qualified legal counsel.
Does not determine consent records or calculate the final EQS score.

use_cases.title: Plan a new prospecting program
use_cases.description: Create a structured sequence before a sales team writes or sends outreach.

use_cases.title: Protect a new sending domain
use_cases.description: Set an estimated warmup ramp and mailbox caps for a new outbound setup.

use_cases.title: Handle reply outcomes consistently
use_cases.description: Define clear next actions and immediate suppression for every reply type.

prompt_templates.title: Start a basic sequence
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a five-step B2B cold outreach sequence for IT directors at mid-market companies. Include timing, a goal, and an exit rule for each step.

prompt_templates.title: Add reply routing
prompt_templates.prompt: Design reply triage for my cold outreach. Route positive, objection, referral, not-now, and opt-out replies to clear next actions.

prompt_templates.title: Plan domain warmup
prompt_templates.prompt: I have three new mailboxes on a fresh domain. Create an estimated weekly warmup ramp and daily sending cap. State the assumptions.

prompt_templates.title: Assess a mixed-jurisdiction list
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a cold outreach sequence for this ICP and identify compliance questions for a list spanning the United States, Canada, and the European Union. Mark unknown consent evidence clearly.

output_examples.input: Plan outreach for a new B2B software product.
output: Five steps with delays, objectives, and stop conditions.
A reply table that suppresses opt-outs immediately.
An estimated warmup ramp with a daily mailbox cap.

output_examples.input: My target list covers several jurisdictions.
output: A sequence plan with jurisdiction questions highlighted.
A request to confirm lawful basis before sending where required.

best_practices: Provide the ICP, list source, sending setup, and target jurisdictions.
Use hard exit rules for replies, opt-outs, and bounces.
Confirm consent and jurisdiction requirements with qualified counsel before sending.
anti_patterns: Do not continue a sequence after an opt-out or reply.
Do not treat estimated warmup volumes as measured deliverability data.
Do not use this skill as a substitute for consent records or legal advice.

faq.question: Does this skill send email?
faq.answer: No. It designs the sequence and guardrails but does not send messages.

faq.question: Can it write the email copy?
faq.answer: No. It defines sequence steps and routes. Use a copywriting skill for message text.

faq.question: Does it handle unsubscribe requests?
faq.answer: It requires immediate suppression and handoff to the consent record process.

faq.question: Does it provide legal advice?
faq.answer: No. It provides operational guidance and asks users to confirm jurisdiction-specific requirements with counsel.

faq.question: Can it calculate email quality scores?
faq.answer: No. It reads relevant sender-integrity evidence but does not calculate the final quality score.

faq.question: What details improve the result?
faq.answer: Provide the ICP, list source, mailbox setup, domain age, current metrics, and target jurisdictions.
